description: Make a new ad for the user's brand modeled on one Sightglass ad: the same layout and style, with all-new copy, the project's brand, products and logo, and no person or product from the original. A project with no brand set up gets an unbranded ad. Renders one finished image into a new Replo Canvas file in the project. Only image ads work; an ad with only a video has no still to start from. This spends the workspace's Replo credits for one image render, so only call it when the user asked for it. It returns the duplicate with status generating, and the render takes about a minute. Call sightglass_show with this call's resultId right away: the card checks on the render itself and shows the finished ad. Poll sightglass_get_ad_duplicate with the duplicate's id only where no card appears or the user asks how it went. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again. For multi-step competitor research, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

adId.description: The ad's own id, from sightglass_find_ads.

direction.description: What to change from the reference, in the user's words (for example 'warmer, lead with the cardigan'). Leave it out to let the reference and the brand steer.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_duplicate_ad
title: Duplicate an ad for my brand
